record.question:
State whether the following are 'True' or 'False'.
(a) The CCS (Leave) Rules, 1972 is applicable to persons paid from contingencies.
(b) As a general rule, it is open to the Competent Authority to grant casual leave in combination with special casual leave.
(c) Leave may not be granted to a Government servant under suspension.
(d) A Government servant serving in a vacation Department is entitled to 'Earned leave' in respect of duty performed in a year in which he avails full vacations.
(e) A Government servant can be granted 'Leave preparatory to retirement' up to 300 days.
